reviews.text: The team at Victory Bark is fantastic! Our dog was treated so well here and the entire process was smooth. I called the office on a Tuesday, brought in our dog for a consultation on Friday afternoon and they were able to take him in for his procedure the following Monday morning. The pricing was fair and Jimmy explained everything thoroughly. Dr Ruth did a wonderful job and we would recommend this clinic for any pet owner!

Dr. Ruth is absolutely amazing.  Personally called to give updates on my Sophie and Jimmy and the amazing lady who came outside to get Sophie were incredibly friendly and helpful.  So thankful for all of the talented people.

The staff here went above and beyond as my brother and I went to visit his cat who had passed away last week while he was out of town. Although he was cold and had already passed, the staff did a wonderful job at preserving and prepping his body and placing him in a position that was comfortable for viewing and touching him before saying our final goodbyes. The attention to detail and their desire to create that space and moment for my brother to say goodbye meant THE WORLD to me. Dr. Sunny Ruth was so incredibly kind and compassionate during this moment. As a hospice nurse myself, I am forever grateful for people who go above and beyond to comfort pet owners as they grieve the loss of their precious pets.
You can tell they TRULY care.
I will forever be thankful for the moment they let us have with our sweet cat Ernie.

Our "Lil' Man" ZenSei (Zennie), a 16-year-old black Manx, has always been extraordinarily healthy and active. However, during his recent annual exam, Dr. Ruth noted he needed a deep dental cleaning and potential extractions.

As a self-admitted "helicopter mom," I cannot rave enough about the care we received. The "curb-side" service is seamless, but it was the people who truly made the difference. From Jimmy and Kelsey’s patient, unhurried attention to Dr. Ruth’s compassion and expertise, every box was checked. Despite my many phone calls, emails and texts, they treated Zennie as if he were their only patient.

Everything went exactly as scheduled on surgery day. Now, just six days later, it’s as if Zennie has found a fountain of youth! His "teenage" energy is back—he’s eating heartily, enjoying his harness walks, and reclaiming his favorite spots in his kitty-condos and on Daddy’s lap. It’s clear those two bad teeth were holding him back. Having owned a business for 30 years, I know the value of a great team. Dr. Ruth, Jimmy, Kelsey, and the whole staff are simply the BEST!!

I would not recommend this clinic due to a prolonged failure to diagnose a persistent medical condition. My German Shepherd was seen here regularly from 2020–2024, and a moderate ear infection went undetected for years despite routine exams.

We adopted him as a stray in 2020 and brought him in for an initial checkup. At that time, he had noticeable ear odor, redness, and dark discharge, though as first-time dog owners we did not recognize this as abnormal. The clinic did not identify or raise concerns about his ears. Over the next several years, he was seen regularly for annual exams and was repeatedly given a clean bill of health, including explicit reassurance that his ears looked normal.

His condition worsened, and I discovered he had a yeast-based ear infection that we successfully treated ourselves. Given the severity and persistence of the symptoms, I feel strongly that this should have been easily identified by a competent veterinarian.

I am giving two stars because the staff was consistently friendly and communicative, and the issue did not result in permanent harm. However, I would not trust them with another animal and I hope that no other animals have suffered due to this clinic's negligence.

These photos are from Sep 2024, and he had just had his annual exam 3 days prior. We have since switched vets and experienced better care, hence providing a benchmark of what good vet care should have looked like.

Thank you very much for your time.

I do not have enough great things to say about Dr. Ruth and Victory Bark as a whole. I have been going to her since 2020 and I have had nothing but great experiences with her and her staff. They are always so friendly and my dog actually gets excited when he realizes where we are going (even though he still always looks back at me like why are you not coming in?? it's great in here!)

I have never been inside the clinic, which I am honestly okay with that because it probably cuts down on a lot of issues, including unfamiliar dogs not getting along.

I cannot really speak to the pricing but it seems reasonable for the care she provides. I routinely take my dog there to have his nails grinded because he is a corgi and she knows that their nails have to be cut in a certain fashion due to how his feet sit.

She is always willing to provide guidance without making you feel rushed. There was one occasion where I called to ask whether something my dog was experiencing was an emergency. It was close to closing time and they told me to bring him by to check him out. After he was examined, it was determined it was not an emergency situation so we made treatment plans and she saved us an ER visit and bill.

Wonderful. Efficient. Integrated with other clinics and services (Paw Lofts, VEG). They help me manage two total knuckleheads with grace.

I can't imagine having a better veterinary than this.

I’ve taken my baby here for Her first checkup and her first yearly annual. I like this clinic. It seems pretty good. The prices seem reasonable. The service is fast and the staff are friendly & definitely flexible. The veterinarian is very kind and provides all the detailed information you need and lots of good health recommendations for your pet. Even though their virtual, they give great recommendations on places you can take your pet for playtime so they can interact with other animals. And you can also book a meeting with the veterinarian so you can meet her ! Overall, great experience will use them again next year!

DO NOT make the mistake of taking your dog here!
I never even met Dr. Sunny Ruth. Her assistants meet you at the parking lot, take your dog inside, and when it’s time to pick them up, you get your dog handed back at the parking lot—no direct contact with the vet, no real explanation of what was done. Just a very expensive bill, a sheet of “after care instructions,” and that’s it.

Unfortunately, that was just the beginning of the nightmare.

It’s been six months since the procedure, and my dog still cannot eat solid food. He gags and vomits if we try. He can now only tolerate special prescription canned food (Science Diet), has lost 4 pounds, and is so thin that his ribs and spine are visible. I took a healthy dog in—and I was given back a broken one.

I called the office multiple times for help, but all I got were vague reassurances from the assistants:
“It’s normal.”
“Give it time.”

Well, six months have passed, and my dog is still suffering. Despite working with my trusted vet, nothing has improved. We are now taking him to a digestive specialist to see if anything can be done to undo the damage.

Please learn from my experience. I regret trusting this clinic with my dog’s care, and I don’t want anyone else to go through what we’re going through.

Dr. Ruth and Jimmy have cared for our dogs for over 10 years. They are the best vet we have ever had in 30+ years of dog ownership. Highly recommended. Thoughtful, thorough, resourceful and above all caring.
A  shining example of support for the DFW pet community.

I was referred to Victory Bark Veterinary clinic by my regular vet for my 10-year old Goldendoodle with a cracked molar.  Since my regular vet does not perform dental surgery,  Dr. Ruth was highly regarded as an expert for this type of surgery.  A consultation visit was scheduled with Dr. Ruth where we discussed the options for my dog.  One thing that was really strange was their front office is not open like a regular vet office, you actually call their number when you arrive and someone (usually Jimmy) comes out to the car to meet you.  Okay, it was a nice day so I didn't mind standing outside.  Another strange thing happened after this, they took my dog in and examined her while I waited outside.  I felt this was quite odd but it was explained to me this practice has been in place since 2020.  During this time, they noticed how calm the dogs remain without going into the waiting room while waiting for the vet to see them.  I voiced my concern since my little girl is rather shy and has "stranger danger" but they assured me it would be just fine.  Well, I was quite surprised how calm she was when she was returned to me after the initial exam!  Fast forward, we scheduled surgery for a Monday, Dr. Ruth recommended removing her tooth to avoid further dental issues.  One thing I was prepared for was the bill.  Having a practice in the downtown Dallas area called the Design District usually equates to a sky high vet bill.  This was not the case, it was VERY affordable to my surprise.
If you are reading this and are referred to Dr. Ruth by your vet, don't even think twice, she is top-notch!  Don't read those negative reviews about this practice, people are more apt to write a negative review rather than a positive one.
A big thanks to Dr. Ruth and Jimmy for taking care of my little girl!

In my time of need I turned to them for guidance on how to best treat my golden retriever. During a rollercoaster of a few weeks I never once felt like I was being financially exploited. Dr. Ruth provided me with every possible solution to best treat my pet. When I did not understand something she would clearly communicate to me the pros/cons of each treatment plan. As a pet owner the last thing we want to do is say goodbye to our fur babies. After speaking with Jimmy, I made the difficult decision to put down my dog. A decision I did not want to take, but ultimately it was the best solution to end my fur baby's suffering. On the day of the procedure the staff was beyond incredible and very respectful. I've never cried so much. To me this was the beginning of life Post-Oliver. It was only after a few days after the procedure had taken place did I realize the important roles these individuals play in society. If it wasn't for their unwavering dedication to serve our animals I'm not sure what type of society we'd be living in. Not to mention the emotional toll it takes on them to see another person, a stranger, crying in front of them as they held their dog for a final embrace goodbye. These are one of the silent unspoken heroes of our society. And to that I say thank you Victory Bark. - Erik

I called and made an appointment on a Friday after Thanksgiving. I got a confirmation call several days before and said I would be there. I then got a call the day of asking if I wanted to come in early because of cancellations but I work night shift and was sleeping. So when I showed up to my appointment at the time, it was originally scheduled the clinic had shut down for the day and did not notify me that they were closing early. So I walked up to a locked building and a voicemail stating that we are closed for the Thanksgiving holiday.
I was only asked to come in earlier, but there was no notification that the clinic would be closing early, this is either a very poor business practice or they need to work on training their staff.
Report has been a trusted veterinarian for my dogs for years.  I fully trust Dr Ruth and her staff to treat my pets and working dogs.
Friendly staff have always been wonderful to our foster kittens!
Always so helpful with my babies.  I know they are in good hands.

They are the best vet clinic in the US not only do they provide good service but there bed side manner is phenomenal. Jimmy and Ruth the vet invited my granddaughter who is extremely interested in becoming a vet to come spend the day with them so she could get hands on experience that is ABOVE AND BEYOND! Thank you thank you to the best Vet family ever you ALL ROCK!!!

I used this clinic for years & spent thousands of dollars with them. I called in to have a routine nail clipping done to my blue nose and was called back after setting appointment that she would need a rabies shot to stay up to date (understandable)

I asked how much that would be and they emailed me an estimate for $340 that included a cocktail of shots my dog doesn't need. Including bordatella.. The only time she's gotten bordatella was when she stayed there a day for a procedure.

I replied that it didn't make sense she need all these other exams and shots if I was told rabies would need to be up to date. The reply from VB stated that if I did not pay for an exam they would deny her meds they prescribed when I went to refill them.

Well. I'll go spend $5000 on a $300 visit with another vet on the principle alone.. Don't ever upsell and make a decision that you're going to not continue prescribing the meds you prescribed if I don't pay for useless exams.
We’ve been taking Rooney here for the past 3 years. They go ABOVE and beyond to be kind and provide the best service. Couldn’t recommend them more!

Everyone here is outstanding. They are knowledgeable, compassionate, and respectful of your time and feelings. Prices are also reasonable. I’m am forever grateful that I found them. It is true that pets need to be dropped off, but the vet calls you and explains everything in detail. I love this place.
Great vet!

I highly recommend bringing your pets to Victory Bark! My cat was referred here by another provider due to a dental issue. The staff is friendly, informative, and very helpful. They took great care of my cat and ensured all my questions …

We took our cat in to get his teeth checked recently (our first visit here) and he ended up needing 11 teeth extracted the next week. I was so nervous for my boy, but the vet and her staff made us confident and comfortable with going ahead …
